appDesc: Detect and download videos and audio from web pages: HLS, DASH, direct files and captured streams.
cmd_default_action: Download the best media of the current tab
always_download_as_menu: Always ask where to save (Download As…)
analyze_failed: Could not read the stream manifest - download may still work.
audio_only_for_this_website: Always audio only for this website
capture_description: Records the stream while it plays (Media Source capture). Works for players without a detectable playlist. Enable, the page reloads, then play the video to the end without seeking and save it here. Does not work with DRM.
capture_disable: Disable stream capture on this site
capture_enable: Enable stream capture on this site
drm_page_warning: This page uses DRM. Protected videos cannot be downloaded.
err_drm: This video is DRM protected. Protected videos are not supported.
history_warning: Download history is off. Do you want ReelFetch to remember your downloads?
hotkeys_hint: Hotkeys: Alt+Up opens ReelFetch, Alt+Down downloads the best media of the tab. Change them in the browser's extension shortcut settings.
need_permission: ReelFetch needs access to websites to detect videos.
nomedia_description: Start the video (and skip ads if any) so it can be detected.
nomedia_title: Can't see the media you're looking for?
show_in_context_menu: Show commands in the right-click menu
smart_naming_hint: Name files from page content: pick a website and a CSS selector or XPath for the element holding the title.
tos_description: ReelFetch is intended for lawful use only: download content you own or are permitted to save. You are responsible for what you download. DRM-protected media is not supported.
transient_history_description: Keep finished downloads in the list
one_hundred_downloads_body: Thanks for using ReelFetch. Enjoy your videos!
reload_clear_cookies: Reload and clear this site's cookies
turbo_capture_hint: Plays the video muted at high speed from the start in the best quality and saves exactly what the player receives. Works on sites that hide their streams (e.g. YouTube).
pick_name: Pick the title from the page…
prefer_original_audio: Prefer original audio (not dubbed or described)
private_browsing_warning: ReelFetch is not enabled in private windows. Turn on that option in the extension settings.
youtube_api: YouTube: get stream links from YouTube's player API (iOS client profile)
err_stalled: Stopped: no progress for too long. Try again or use Turbo capture.
err_tab_closed: The tab was closed before the capture finished.
update_busy: Finish or cancel the running downloads first.
update_manual_hint: Download the new setup and run it to update.
turbo_partial: Partial: the site stopped playback, saved
